office_does: The Assessor appraises all taxable property in Okanogan County at market value under state law, calculates levies and runs the property tax exemption programs.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Assessor Larry D Gilman (Prefers Republican Party), in office since 2019, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Okanogan County Assessor since 2019 after 31 years in the office, starting as a residential appraiser; the only candidate.
highlights: Assessor since 2019; 31 years in the Assessor's office [S1]
Says the office's role is 'to represent all citizens of Okanogan County equally and fairly' [S1]
